T001.text: Students in the retrieval practice condition scored 8.4 percentage points higher on the cumulative final exam than students in the re-reading condition (d = 0.52, p < .001).

T002.text: On a delayed test eight weeks later, quizzed topics were answered correctly 61% of the time compared with 52% for review topics. Immediate post-unit scores did not differ.

T003.text: Mean final exam score was 72.1% in the spaced retrieval cohort and 67.5% in the massed homework cohort. The DFW rate fell from 19% to 14%.
Because cohorts were not randomly assigned, differences in student preparation between years cannot be ruled out.

T004.text: Retrieval practice improved unit exam performance by 6.1 percentage points and transfer problem performance by 9.3 percentage points relative to open-book study.
